headline: OpenAI GPT-6.1 Terra Launches with Halved API Prices, Boosting Local Deployment
summary: OpenAI has unveiled GPT-6.1 Terra, a mid-range model that halves API prices, making advanced AI capabilities more accessible. This move is driving local AI agent deployment and reshaping the competitive landscape.
whyItMatters: Reduced costs will accelerate the adoption of advanced AI models, particularly in smaller organizations and local markets, fostering broader innovation and competition.
